items.title_en: Fixing the Portobello Police Station Clock
items.title_zh: 修复波托贝洛警察局的时钟
items.summary_en: An on-site repair of a long-standing public clock at Portobello Police Station highlights the practical challenges of keeping public infrastructure accurate. The piece walks through diagnosis, component choices, and the care required to maintain legacy devices in a public setting.
items.summary_zh: 在波托贝洛警察局对长期使用的公开时钟进行现场修复，展示保持公共基础设施准时性的实际挑战。文章梳理诊断过程、部件选择以及维护老旧设备的要点。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra has gained the ability to drive a car
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 拥有驾车能力
items.summary_en: GPT-6 Astra has gained the ability to drive a car, suggesting integration of advanced AI with autonomous vehicle control. The capability raises questions about safety, control, and regulatory compliance, and could accelerate AI-assisted driving tools.
items.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 已获得驾驶汽车的能力，显示出先进 AI 与自动驾驶控制的整合前景。这一能力引发关于安全性、控制权与监管合规性的讨论，并可能推动 AI 辅助驾驶工具的普及。

items.title_en: Italian parliament votes for return to nuclear energy
items.title_zh: 意大利国会通过核能回归
items.summary_en: Italy's parliament voted to reintroduce nuclear energy as part of its energy mix, signaling a strategic shift toward energy diversification and decarbonization. The move could spur regulatory, investment, and public-privacy debates around new reactors or small modular reactors.
items.summary_zh: 意大利议会通过重启核能计划来丰富能源结构，体现对能源多样化和减排的战略转向。此举可能推动新型核能技术、监管框架和相关投资的讨论与部署。

items.title_en: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when telemetry is on [fixed]
items.title_zh: Claude Code 仅在开启遥测时读取 AGENTS.md 的问题已修复
items.summary_en: Claude Code previously read AGENTS.md only when telemetry was enabled, a privacy quirk that could leak policy-facing content under certain settings. The update fixes the behavior, decoupling file access from telemetry so policy information isn’t conditionally exposed. It underscores ongoing attention to privacy controls in AI-assisted development tools.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 之前仅在遥测开启时读取 AGENTS.md，这一隐私问题在某些设置下可能导致策略性内容泄露。此次修复将数据访问与遥测状态解耦，使策略性文档的读取不再依赖遥测，提升隐私保护与可预测性。该事件反映了在 AI 辅助开发工具中对隐私控制的持续关注。

items.title_en: 28% of job postings on company career sites have been open over 90 days
items.title_zh: 公司职业站点中有 90 天以上的职位比例
items.summary_en: A report finds 28% of job postings on company career sites have been open for more than 90 days, signaling hiring frictions and misalignment in workforce planning. The trend highlights inefficiencies in talent acquisition and potential misrepresentation of urgency to candidates.
items.summary_zh: 报告显示，企业招聘网站上有 28% 的职位自上线起超过 90 天仍未关闭，反映招聘流程的摩擦与人力规划的错配。此现象揭示招聘效率低下及对求职者传达紧迫性方面的潜在误导。

items.title_en: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.8 文本转语音
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.8 expands text-to-speech capabilities, delivering more natural prosody and faster generation for scalable applications. The update broadens multilingual support and improves voice customization, impacting accessibility tools, IVR, and content creation.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 3.8 在文本转语音方面提升了自然度和生成速度，便于在大规模场景中使用。扩展的多语言支持与更灵活的声音自定义，将影响无障碍、语音交互与内容创作等领域。

items.title_en: I don't want the details
items.title_zh: 我不想要细节
items.summary_en: A piece arguing that for certain audiences, high-level explanations trump technical minutiae, focusing on practical implications rather than details.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张在某些场景下，概括性解释比技术细节更有价值，聚焦实际影响而非细枝末节。

items.title_en: Samsung accidentally freezes its smart fridges with a software update
items.title_zh: 三星软件更新意外让智能冰箱冻结
items.summary_en: A staged software update for Samsung smart fridges unexpectedly froze devices, sometimes locking the touchscreen or disrupting cooling features. The incident highlights the fragility of IoT firmware rollouts and why robust rollback and testing are essential.
items.summary_zh: 三星的一次软件更新意外使智能冰箱进入冻结状态，部分设备触屏失灵或功能异常，影响使用体验。此事件暴露了物联网固件更新的脆弱性，强调需要更稳健的回滚和测试流程。

items.title_en: Jev in 25 Lines of Python
items.title_zh: 用 25 行 Python 实现 Jev
items.summary_en: A compact 25-line Python snippet illustrating Jev.
items.summary_zh: 用 25 行 Python 展示 Jev 的简要实现。

items.title_en: Strands Harness
items.title_zh: Strands Harness
items.summary_en: Strands Harness offers a modular framework to build and orchestrate AI agents, focusing on tool use, memory, and planning. It aims to simplify composing complex autonomous systems and enables scalable agent workflows.
items.summary_zh: Strands Harness 提供一个模块化框架，用于构建与编排 AI 代理，着重工具调用、记忆与计划能力，旨在简化复杂自治系统的组合与扩展。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.title_zh: GPT-6：Sol 与 Luna
items.summary_en: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 variants Sol and Luna, signaling another step in model scaling and capability expansion. The release emphasizes modular capabilities, improved reasoning and planning, and closer integration with tools and environments, which could accelerate enterprise AI deployments and spark competitive responses.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 公开了 GPT-6 的 Sol 与 Luna 版本，标志着模型扩展和能力提升的新阶段。新版本强调模块化能力、改进的推理与规划，并加强与工具及环境的集成，这可能推动企业级 AI 应用的落地并引发行业竞争。

items.title_en: UK military jamming other nations' satellites to defend itself, BBC told
items.title_zh: 英国军方为自卫干扰其他国家卫星，BBC称
items.summary_en: Britain's defense establishment reportedly considered or employed satellite jamming against other nations in defense scenarios, according to BBC reporting. This raises legal, strategic, and civilian-impact questions about space warfare and cross-border interference in the space domain.
items.summary_zh: 据 BBC 报道，英国军方在自卫情境下干扰其他国家卫星的能力成为公开议题，引发对太空战、跨境干扰以及对民用通信影响的讨论。

items.title_en: Seattle City Council votes to ban surveillance pricing in sale of groceries
items.title_zh: 西雅图通过禁止在杂货销售中的监控定价
items.summary_en: Seattle votes to ban surveillance pricing in grocery sales, restricting how retailers use customer data to adjust prices. The measure aims to protect privacy and ensure fair pricing, with potential ripple effects on retailers and other cities.
items.summary_zh: 西雅图市议会通过禁止在杂货销售中使用监控数据进行定价的法案，限制商家依赖顾客数据来调整价格，旨在提升隐私保护与价格公平。这一举措可能影响零售商策略并引发其他城市的模仿。

items.title_en: Claude Opus 5.5
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 版本
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5.5 is the latest update in Anthropic's Claude series, focusing on improved intelligence, faster inference, and better cost efficiency. Early benchmarks suggest more robust reasoning and longer context handling, making it attractive for production-grade applications.
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 是 Anthropic Claude 系列的最新版本，强调智能性、推理速度和成本效益的提升。初步评测显示其在真实场景中的推理更稳健、上下文处理能力更强，适合用于生产级应用。

items.title_en: Stripe's Knowledge AI Platform
items.title_zh: Stripe 的 Knowledge AI 平台
items.summary_en: Stripe unveils Knowledge AI Platform to centralize and empower knowledge retrieval across products, enabling developers and merchants to find answers quickly and automate support workflows. The platform marks Stripe's push into enterprise AI tooling with emphasis on privacy controls and integration with existing docs.
items.summary_zh: Stripe 发布 Knowledge AI 平台，聚合并加速跨产品的知识检索，帮助开发者与商家快速找到答案并自动化支持流程。此举体现 Stripe 将 AI 企业级工具包装上线，并强调隐私控制与对现有文档生态的整合。

items.title_en: The GitHub wiki is an anti-pattern (2022)
items.title_zh: GitHub Wiki 是反模式（2022）
items.summary_en: An opinion piece argues GitHub Wikis are an anti-pattern in modern project docs, promoting structured docs and dedicated docs sites instead, with rationale and best practices.
items.summary_zh: 评论认为 GitHub Wiki 已成为现代项目文档的反模式，建议使用结构化文档和专门的文档站点，并给出原因与实践建议。

items.title_en: Radicle: Disclosure of Vulnerability in the Network Protocol
items.title_zh: Radicle：网络协议漏洞披露
items.summary_en: Radicle disclosed a vulnerability in its network protocol and outlined mitigation steps, a patch timeline, and future hardening efforts. The disclosure underscores the ongoing importance of securing peer-to-peer protocols in open-source projects.
items.summary_zh: Radicle 公布其网络协议漏洞，并给出缓解措施、修复时间表与后续加固计划。此事凸显了在点对点协议中确保安全性及负责任披露在开源项目中的重要性。

items.title_en: Pentagon says overreliance on AI contributed to missile strike on Iran school
items.title_zh: 五角大楼称对伊朗一所学校袭击的过度依赖 AI 起了作用
items.summary_en: Pentagon officials say overreliance on AI decision-support contributed to miscalculations in a 2026 Iran school attack, highlighting risks of automated guidance in high-stakes decisions. The piece raises questions about governance, human-in-the-loop, and the reliability of AI in combat contexts.
items.summary_zh: 五角大楼官员称对 AI 决策支持的过度依赖在 该次伊朗学校袭击中造成了误判，凸显了在高风险决策中使用自动化工具的风险。文章提出关于治理、人工参与与军事领域 AI 可靠性的问题。

items.summary_en: A browser-based Z80 REPL from 2018 lets users experiment with Z80 assembly and see immediate results, illustrating the ongoing appeal of browser-based retro computing and education.
items.summary_zh: 这是一款可在浏览器中运行的 Z80 REPL，允许用户直接编写并观察 Z80 汇编的即时执行结果，展示了网页端复古计算的持续魅力与教育潜力。

items.title_en: 'We hacked the FBI:' Hackers say they have data on all FBI employees
items.title_zh: ‘黑客称已入侵 FBI：掌握所有雇员数据’
items.summary_en: Hackers claim they breached the FBI and obtained data on all employees, a claim that authorities and researchers should verify. The incident underscores the dangers of misinformation and the ongoing importance of strong security practices and rapid incident response.
items.summary_zh: 黑客声称入侵了 FBI，获得了所有雇员的数据，但尚无可靠证据证实。此事揭示了信息错传的风险，以及加强凭证安全和事件响应的持续必要性。

items.title_en: Grammarly will send unhinged messages to all your users if you try to cancel
items.title_zh: 尝试取消订阅时 Grammarly 可能向所有用户发送失控消息
items.summary_en: A warning about cancellation flows: Grammarly reportedly triggers mass notifications to all users when an account is canceled, illustrating risks around exit processes and privacy. Highlights considerations for notification policies and user experience.
items.summary_zh: 警示：在取消订阅的流程中，Grammarly 可能向所有用户发送大量通知，暴露退出流程的隐私和体验风险。提醒读者关注通知策略、数据保护的边界和用户体验。

items.title_en: Tokens Too Cheap to Meter
items.title_zh: Tokens Too Cheap to Meter
items.summary_en: Explores the paradox of AI tokens being cheap enough to encourage wasteful usage, arguing for pricing models that reflect compute costs to prevent abuse and ensure sustainability.
items.summary_zh: 讨论用于 AI 服务计费的代币价格过低，鼓励资源浪费的现象。提出对成本进行真实反映的定价模型，以防滥用并实现可持续发展。

items.title_en: What to do when your Waymo holds up a Secret Service motorcade
items.title_zh: Waymo 搞定秘密服务车队的事件中的应对
items.summary_en: Waymo incident where its self-driving car delayed a Secret Service motorcade raises questions about safety protocols, escalation procedures, and the role of autonomous vehicles in critical security operations.
items.summary_zh: Waymo 自动驾驶车拖延秘密服务车队事件暴露出安全协议、应急流程与自动驾驶在关键安全行动中的角色等问题。

items.title_en: Apple has added persistent 'ads' to iOS, and it's driving users crazy
items.title_zh: 苹果在 iOS 中加入持续性广告，让用户抓狂
items.summary_en: Apple has rolled out persistent ads in iOS, inserting ads into areas that users can't easily avoid, triggering backlash. The move underscores ongoing tensions between platform monetization and user experience on a tightly controlled OS. For developers and power users, the shift may force reconsideration of app design and ad strategies on iPhone.
items.summary_zh: 苹果在 iOS 中引入持续广告，强行出现在用户难以避开的界面区域，激起广泛不满。此举凸显了在受控生态中的商业化与用户体验之间的张力。对于开发者和重度用户而言，这一变化可能促使重新审视在 iPhone 上的应用设计和广告策略。

items.title_en: Jev Can't Be Calibrated
items.title_zh: Jev 不能被校准
items.summary_en: A provocative take arguing that calibration cannot fix underlying issues in AI or systems, critiquing overreliance on calibration as a cure-all.
items.summary_zh: 一篇挑衅性观点认为对 Jev 的校准无法解决根本问题，批评过分依赖校准作为万金油的做法。

items.title_en: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005
items.title_zh: GPT–6 Astra 破译自 2005 年以来未解的 Enigma 密文
items.summary_en: GPT‑6 Astra allegedly breaks an Enigma cipher that stumped researchers since 2005. If validated, this would mark a notable advance in AI-assisted cryptanalysis and raise questions about reproducibility and security implications. The claim invites scrutiny of data, methods, and whether such results can be reliably replicated.
items.summary_zh: 据称，GPT‑6 Astra 已破解自2005年以来一直未解的恩尼格玛密文。若为真，这将标志着AI辅助密码分析的显著进展，同时也引发对可重复性与安全性的质疑。对此类结果的可验证性、数据来源与实验方法需接受严格审视。

items.title_en: Microsoft killed FoxPro in 2007. Anyway, here's FoxPro revived
items.title_zh: 微软在2007年终止 FoxPro，但如今 FoxPro 似乎又被复活
items.summary_en: FoxPro lives on in a fan-driven revival after Microsoft pulled the plug in 2007. The project revives familiar xBase idioms with modern tooling, enabling new and legacy apps to co-exist. It shows how niche communities can sustain long-lived ecosystems through open-source experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 尽管微软在2007年停止了 FoxPro，但社区仍在以 FoxScript 等方式让其精神延续。新项目提供现代化工具，旨在让遗留应用重获活力，并让新旧代码并存。此举显示开源社区如何通过协作维持长期存在的生态系统。

items.title_en: Transit rewards
items.title_zh: 交通奖励计划
items.summary_en: Waymo unveils a transit rewards program designed to incentivize riders to choose transit options within its mobility platform, offering points for trips and ways to redeem them with partners. The move signals continued experimentation with incentive-driven, multimodal mobility and could steer future routing and partnerships.
items.summary_zh: Waymo 推出交通奖励计划，激励用户在其出行生态中选择公共交通，并通过合作伙伴兑现积分。此举体现了以激励驱动的多模式出行趋势，可能影响未来的路线规划与合作关系。

items.title_en: Community condemn Bedminster AI mural as 'insult' to artists
items.title_zh: 社区谴责 Bedminster 的 AI 壁画为对艺术家的侮辱
items.summary_en: Local community condemns an AI-generated mural in Bedminster as insulting to artists, sparking debates over AI-generated art, authorship, and compensation. The incident fuels policy discussions around AI in public art.
items.summary_zh: 社区将 Bedminster 的 AI 壁画视为对艺术家的侮辱，引发关于 AI 艺术、署名与报酬的讨论，并推动公共艺术领域的政策讨论。

items.title_en: MiMo v2.6
items.title_zh: MiMo v2.6 版本发布
items.summary_en: MiMo v2.6 delivers smarter on-device features and improved performance for the Mimo platform, with expanded device compatibility and enhanced developer tooling. The update emphasizes edge AI enhancements and energy efficiency, underscoring Xiaomi's push toward smarter, more capable IoT and edge devices.
items.summary_zh: MiMo v2.6 带来智能化功能和性能提升，扩展设备兼容性并强化开发工具。更新强调边缘 AI 的改进与能效提升，凸显小米在更智能、更强大边缘设备上的持续投入。

items.title_en: SAML: A fractal of bad design
items.title_zh: SAML：坏设计的分形
items.summary_en: Trail of Bits argues that SAML's architecture creates a cascade of security and usability pitfalls, from brittle trust relationships to misconfigurations that scale poorly in large orgs. The piece helps readers understand why enterprise identity has remained hard and what to consider when designing federated auth.
items.summary_zh: Trail of Bits 指出 SAML 的架构滋生了层层的安全与可用性陷阱，从脆弱的信任关系到在大型组织中难以扩展的配置错误。该文帮助读者理解为何企业身份管理一直难以解决，以及在设计联合认证时应考虑的要点。

items.title_en: Claude Opus 5.5 Intelligence, Performance and Price Analysis (Max)
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 Max 的智能、性能与价格分析
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5.5 Max is pitched as the premium variant with top-tier intelligence, speed, and cost-performance. The analysis highlights where it dominates smaller models, while exposing limits in latency or ecosystem integration that buyers should consider.
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 Max 被定位为高端版本，在智能性、速度和性价比方面表现突出。分析指出它在某些任务上优于小型模型，但在延迟和生态系统集成方面也有局限，购买时需权衡。

items.title_en: AI Is a Boring Technology
items.title_zh: AI 是一门无聊的技术
items.summary_en: A contrarian take argues that AI is a boring technology in practice, urging more emphasis on practical, reliable deployments rather than flashy demos. It discusses implications for startups, enterprises, and user expectations.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为人工智能在实际应用中其实相当无聊，建议把重点放在稳健、可持续的落地场景，而非追逐炫酷演示。对初创公司、企业与用户期望有启示作用。

items.title_en: Abandoning Scientific Linux Was a Mistake
items.title_zh: 放弃 Scientific Linux 是一个错误的决定
items.summary_en: The author argues that Scientific Linux offered long-term support, binary compatibility, and stability for scientific workloads that generic distributions lack. Abandoning it forced researchers to migrate to less tested stacks, increasing maintenance burden and risk. The piece suggests organizations should weigh stability and reproducibility when choosing platforms.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为 Scientific Linux 提供长期支持、二进制兼容性和稳定性，适合科学计算工作负载，而通用发行版往往无法比肩。放弃它迫使研究人员迁移到未经充分测试的栈，增加了维护成本和风险。文章建议在选择平台时，优先考虑稳定性与可重复性。

items.title_en: What to Know About JavaScript in 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年 JavaScript 的要点
items.summary_en: Overview of JavaScript in 2026: feature trajectories, evolving runtimes, and tooling shifts, with emphasis on modularization, server components, performance, and security best practices.
items.summary_zh: 总结 2026 年 JavaScript 的关键趋势，包括语言新特性、运行时演变、工具链变化，以及模块化、服务端组件、性能与安全的关注要点。

items.title_en: There's a high chance of devices being sold with GrapheneOS preinstalled in 2027
items.title_zh: 到 2027 年设备很大概率预装 GrapheneOS
items.summary_en: GrapheneOS preinstalled on devices would mark a significant privacy-first trend in consumer hardware. If it materializes, expect a shake-up for OEMs and a push for easier update paths and security hardening, while challenges around app compatibility remain.
items.summary_zh: 设备出厂预装 GrapheneOS 将标志着隐私优先的硬件趋势。如果成为现实，原厂/厂商将面临压力，更新与安全性强化的需求上升，应用兼容性仍是需要解决的难点。

items.title_en: I am done with this shit
items.title_zh: 这玩意儿我受够了
items.summary_en: An outspoken post venting about Claude AI, highlighting reliability, safety filters, and workflow friction. It reflects broader frustration with current AI assistants and the demand for more dependable, controllable tools.
items.summary_zh: 一篇直言不讳的发帖，抨击 Claude AI 的可靠性、安全过滤与工作流阻碍。它反映了对现有 AI 助手的普遍挫败感，以及对更可靠、可控工具的需求。

items.title_en: OpenAI is well positioned to fast-follow Jev
items.title_zh: OpenAI 有望迅速紧随 Jev 的步伐
items.summary_en: OpenAI is well positioned to quickly follow Jev, leveraging its scale, data access, and ecosystem to roll out similar features. The move underscores how incumbents can weather fast-moving AI launches by acting in tandem rather than from scratch.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 拥有规模、数据与生态系统的优势，具备快速跟进 Jev 发布的条件。这一策略凸显了大厂在快速迭代的 AI 发布中，通过协同跟进来保持领先性。

items.title_en: Unreal Agent
items.title_zh: Unreal Agent：虚幻引擎中的 AI 代理
items.summary_en: Unreal Agent introduces an AI-powered agent framework for the Unreal ecosystem, enabling autonomous behavior, planning, and decision-making within games and simulations. The project could lower barriers for developers to ship intelligent, interactive experiences.
items.summary_zh: Unreal Agent 在虚幻生态中引入 AI 驱动的代理框架，使游戏与仿真环境中的自主行为、规划与决策成为可能。这将降低开发者构建智能、互动体验的门槛。

items.title_en: Hubble Network Opens Satellite Coverage to All Bluetooth Devices
items.title_zh: Hubble Network 将卫星覆盖扩展到所有蓝牙设备
items.summary_en: Hubble Network opens satellite coverage to all Bluetooth devices, enabling broader accessibility but raising privacy and security considerations as well as potential regulatory questions. The funding round signals momentum for satellite-to-device integration.
items.summary_zh: Hubble Network 将卫星覆盖扩展到所有蓝牙设备，扩大了接入范围的同时也带来隐私与安全以及监管方面的新挑战。融资高增长显示了卫星与设备互联的持续热度。

items.title_en: WordPress: Unauthenticated path traversal leading to conditional RCE
items.title_zh: WordPress：未认证路径遍历引发条件性远程代码执行
items.summary_en: An unauthenticated path traversal flaw in WordPress can lead to conditional remote code execution under specific setups. Remediation requires applying patched versions and hardening the environment against attacker-controlled file paths.
items.summary_zh: 存在未认证的路径遍历漏洞，特定条件下可实现条件性远程代码执行。修复需升级到修补版本并加强对攻击者可控文件路径的防护。

items.title_en: Data-only attacks are easier than you think (2024)
items.title_zh: 数据仅攻击比你想象的更容易（2024）
items.summary_en: Data-only attacks, where adversaries manipulate data or inputs to influence a system without code execution, are more feasible than many assume. The article outlines practical techniques from 2024 and recommends stronger data validation, provenance checks, and anomaly detection to mitigate risk.
items.summary_zh: 数据仅攻击比想象更易实现，攻击者通过操控数据或输入来影响系统而无需执行代码。文中总结了2024年的实际攻击手段，并建议加强数据验证、溯源和异常检测以降低风险。

items.title_en: Obscura: VPN that can't log your activity
items.title_zh: Obscura：无法记录活动日志的 VPN
items.summary_en: Obscura promotes a VPN designed to not log activity; the piece covers its architecture, threat model, and what zero-logging can realistically guarantee, plus caveats about audits and trust assumptions.
items.summary_zh: Obscura 推出声称“不可记录活动日志”的 VPN，介绍其架构、威胁模型以及零日志在现实中的保证范围，同时提醒读者关注审计与信任假设的局限。

items.title_en: AMD's random number generator can't generate a 0?
items.title_zh: AMD 的随机数生成器不能产生 0 吗？
items.summary_en: An edge-case in a RNG shows it cannot produce zero, raising questions about design and testing. The quirk underscores the importance of thorough validation for randomness generators, especially in security-sensitive contexts.
items.summary_zh: RNG 的一个边界情况显示无法输出 0，这引发对设计与测试的质疑。此类罕见输出的存在强调在安全相关场景下对随机数生成器进行全面验证的重要性。

items.title_en: The current balance of power in open models
items.title_zh: 开放模型的力量格局现状
items.summary_en: The piece surveys the current power balance in open models, outlining who controls access to models, compute, and governance, and how openness interacts with safety and competition.
items.summary_zh: 文章梳理当前开放模型领域的力量对比，阐述谁掌控模型获取、计算资源及治理，以及开放性如何影响安全、创新和市场竞争。

items.title_en: What California is learning from solar panels built over irrigation canals
items.title_zh: 加州从灌溉运河上建造的太阳能板学到的经验
items.summary_en: California is piloting solar installations over irrigation canals to save land, reduce water interaction, and improve grid resilience; the piece discusses lessons learned for scalable solar deployment and water management. It highlights how such dual-use infrastructure can help balance energy demand, agricultural needs, and environmental goals.
items.summary_zh: 加州正在尝试在灌溉运河上方部署太阳能板，以节省土地、降低对水资源的影响并提升电网韧性。文章探讨了可扩展太阳能部署与水资源管理的经验教训，强调此类双用途基础设施在满足能源、农业与环境目标之间的平衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: Drop – A rootless Linux sandbox with gVisor support
items.title_zh: Show HN：Drop——一个无根 Linux 沙箱，支持 gVisor
items.summary_en: Drop is a rootless Linux sandbox with gVisor support, enabling safer experimentation on devices without root access. It targets developers and researchers needing isolated environments with modern container isolation.
items.summary_zh: Drop 是一个无根的 Linux 沙箱，支持 gVisor，便于在无 Root 权限的设备上进行安全的隔离测试。面向需要现代容器隔离的开发者与研究者。

items.title_en: Native apps written in TypeScript and CSS
items.title_zh: 用 TypeScript 与 CSS 编写的原生应用
items.summary_en: GitHub examples showcase native apps built with web technologies like TypeScript and CSS, aiming to deliver near-native performance with familiar tooling. The collection illustrates a possible path for developers to ship cross-platform apps without abandoning the web tech ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 的示例项目展示了用 TypeScript 与 CSS 构建原生应用的可能性，力求在保留常用工具链的同时实现接近原生的性能。该合集为开发者提供了跨平台应用的一条可行路径，而不必放弃网页技术生态。

items.title_en: How often do you think about the 1893 World's Fair?
items.title_zh: 你多久会想起1893年的世界博览会？
items.summary_en: Readers are invited to consider how the 1893 World’s Fair shaped early demonstrations of electricity, mass media, and urban design. The piece ties that landmark event to today's tech optimism and how public exhibitions can seed long-lasting infrastructure and hype. It suggests reflecting on what from history endures versus what fades in the hype cycle.
items.summary_zh: 读者被引导思考1893年世界博览会如何塑造了电力、大众传媒与城市设计的早期展示。文章将这一历史事件与今日的科技乐观主义和公共展览如何催生持久基础设施与炒作联系起来。它提醒人们要分辨历史遗产与容易褪色的炒作之间的区别。

items.title_en: 16-bit Intel 8088 chip (c. 1985)
items.title_zh: 16 位 Intel 8088 芯片
items.summary_en: The 16-bit Intel 8088 powered early PCs by marrying a 16-bit internal core with an 8-bit external bus, enabling IBM PC compatibility. The design choice balanced cost and performance and laid the groundwork for widespread software compatibility.
items.summary_zh: 8088 将 16 位内部核心与 8 位外部总线相结合，支撑了早期个人电脑的兼容性。这一设计在成本与性能之间取得平衡，为广泛的软件兼容性奠定基础。

items.title_en: People hooked on vapes try a new way to quit: cigarettes
items.title_zh: 戒电子烟的人尝试以香烟来戒烟
items.summary_en: Some vapers attempting to quit are returning to cigarettes, highlighting the ongoing complexities of nicotine cessation and the role of devices as nicotine delivery systems.
items.summary_zh: 一些曾使用电子烟的人在戒烟路上转向香烟，揭示戒烟过程的复杂性以及设备在尼古丁获取中的作用。

items.title_en: The darker side of being a doctor
items.title_zh: 身为医生的阴暗面
items.summary_en: Doctors face burnout, long hours, and the emotional toll of patient outcomes, which often go unseen by patients and administrators. The piece sheds light on the human costs behind clinical care, from moral distress to administrative burdens that siphon time away from patients. It also hints at how smarter workflows, mental health support, and better doctor-patient collaboration could improve resilience and care quality.
items.summary_zh: 医生承受职业疲惫、长工时和病人结局带来的情感压力，这些往往被患者和管理者忽视。文章揭示临床护理背后的人性成本，从道德困境到行政负担都在挤压医生照护时间。并提出通过更智能的工作流程、心理健康支持以及更好的医患协作来提升韧性和护理质量的可能性。

items.title_en: The UV index is not the warm sensation of sunlight on bare skin
items.title_zh: UV 指数不是阳光在皮肤上的温暖感
items.summary_en: The UV index measures ultraviolet radiation, not warmth, a common misconception. The post explains what the index signals for sun exposure risk and how to act on it in daily life.
items.summary_zh: UV 指数衡量的是紫外辐射强度，而非温暖感，很多人易混淆。文中解释了指数对日晒风险的指示以及日常防护要点。

items.title_en: Writing Rust code that's fast by asking agents to make the code faster
items.title_zh: 让代理优化 Rust 代码以提升速度
items.summary_en: Using AI agents to optimize Rust code demonstrates exploratory agentic iteration, where automation suggests and implements improvements. The approach can yield speedups but also risks subtle bugs or suboptimal changes if not monitored.
items.summary_zh: 通过让 AI 代理来优化 Rust 代码，展示了代理式迭代的思路：自动提出并实现改进。此方法可能带来显著速度提升，但若缺乏监控，也可能引入隐性 bug 或次优改动。

items.title_en: Show HN: JevBench, a reproducible benchmark for typed decision models
items.title_zh: JevBench：面向类型化决策模型的可重复基准
items.summary_en: JevBench introduces a reproducible benchmark for typed decision models, enabling researchers to fairly compare model behavior and decision accuracy. The project helps standardize evaluation in the rapidly evolving field.
items.summary_zh: JevBench 引入一套可重复的类型化决策模型基准，帮助研究者在可比的设置下公平比较模型行为与决策准确性。该项目推动了这一快速发展领域的评估标准化。

items.title_en: Markdown in /src
items.title_zh: 在 /src 使用 Markdown
items.summary_en: HTMX argues for embedding Markdown in the /src tree to improve readability and lightweight documentation alongside code, with tooling to automate docs from source.
items.summary_zh: HTMX 提倡在 /src 目录中使用 Markdown 以提升可读性和轻量级文档化，并提供工具将文档与源码自动集成。

items.title_en: Solitaire Alone Together
items.title_zh: Solitaire Alone Together
items.summary_en: Solitaire Alone Together explores social themes through a seemingly solitary activity, pairing intimate design with a sense of shared experience. It's a commentary on connection in a connected age, wrapped in a minimalistic game or project.
items.summary_zh: Solitaire Alone Together 通过看似独处的活动探讨社会主题，将亲密设计与共同体验感结合在一起。这是对在联结时代人际联系的反思，包裹在极简的游戏或项目中。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Coverage Cat (YC S22) – Umbrella insurance via your personal agent
items.title_zh: Coverage Cat（YC S22）——通过个人代理提供伞形保险
items.summary_en: Coverage Cat offers umbrella insurance through a personal agent, promising a more transparent, hands-on buying experience. The model aims to simplify underwriting and claims, potentially appealing to customers who dislike opaque coverage terms.
items.summary_zh: Coverage Cat 通过个人代理提供伞形保险，承诺提供更透明、贴身的购买体验。该模式意在简化承保与理赔流程，可能吸引对条款不透明不满意的用户。

items.title_en: Did OpenAI solve the wrong Navier-Stokes problem?
items.title_zh: OpenAI 是否解决错了 Navier–Stokes 问题？
items.summary_en: Scientific American questions whether AI progress targeted at Navier–Stokes equations addressed the most meaningful formulation, and discusses limits of data-driven models in solving classical PDEs. The piece underscores the gap between pattern recognition in ML and rigorous mathematical guarantees in physics.
items.summary_zh: Scientific American 质疑将 AI 进展用于求解 Navier–Stokes 方程是否聚焦在最具意义的问题，并讨论数据驱动模型在求解经典偏微分方程方面的局限。文章强调了机器学习的模式识别能力与物理学中严格数学保证之间的差距。

items.title_en: Show HN: Training a model to identify AI web content from structure alone
items.title_zh: Show HN：仅通过结构识别 AI 网页内容的模型训练
items.summary_en: Researchers train a model to detect AI-generated web content using only structural cues, independent of text semantics. This approach could enable faster, scalable content-authentication pipelines and inform moderation and provenance tracking.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员训练一个模型仅基于网页结构线索来识别 AI 生成的网页内容，而不依赖文本语义。此方法有望提供可扩展的内容认证与源追溯工具，并支持内容审核场景。

items.title_en: ReBarUEFI: Resizable BAR for almost any UEFI system
items.title_zh: ReBarUEFI：几乎所有 UEFI 系统的可伸缩 BAR 支持
items.summary_en: ReBarUEFI brings Resizable BAR support to a broad swath of UEFI systems, enabling dynamic GPU memory mappings without changing hardware. By enabling BAR resizing at firmware level, it broadens compatibility and could unlock modest performance gains for enthusiasts on older platforms. It's a reminder that firmware tinkering can squeeze extra life from existing rigs.
items.summary_zh: ReBarUEFI 让大量被支持的 UEFI 系统具备可伸缩显存条功能，提升显存映射的灵活性。通过固件层面的改造实现 BAR 大小调节，扩大对旧平台的兼容性，并有望带来一定的性能提升。提醒人们对固件层优化也能挖掘硬件潜力。

items.title_en: Show HN: Npunlock – Run custom C kernels for Intel NPUs
items.title_zh: Show HN：Npunlock——在 Intel NPU 上运行自定义 C 内核
items.summary_en: Npunlock is a Show HN project that lets developers run custom C kernels on Intel NPUs, enabling experimentation outside the official SDKs. It highlights both potential performance gains and concerns around stability, security, and vendor restrictions.
items.summary_zh: Npunlock 是一个 Show HN 项目，允许在英特尔 NPU 上运行自定义 C 内核，便于绕过官方 SDK 进行实验。它既展示了开放性带来的潜在性能收益，也引发关于稳定性、安全性和厂商限制的担忧。

items.title_en: ArchiveBox v0.9 released with new native apps and 50 new plugins
items.title_zh: ArchiveBox 0.9 发布，新增原生应用与 50 插件
items.summary_en: ArchiveBox 0.9 expands the self-hosted archiving toolkit with native apps and 50 plugins, broadening how users capture and preserve web content offline. The release strengthens offline privacy and automation for teams that prefer to avoid cloud services.
items.summary_zh: ArchiveBox 0.9 通过原生应用与新增的 50 个插件扩展了自托管归档工具的能力，覆盖网页、PDF、媒体等离线存储场景。此次更新提升了对隐私保护需求的支持，并减少对云服务的依赖。

items.title_en: ShinyHunters claims FBI hack: 'This is NOT financially motivated'
items.title_zh: ShinyHunters 声称入侵 FBI：这并非出于金钱动机
items.summary_en: ShinyHunters publicly claims their alleged FBI hack is not financially motivated, challenging typical crimeware narratives. It underscores the importance of cautious credential leakage, threat intelligence, and verifying such claims.
items.summary_zh: ShinyHunters 公开宣称其对 FBI 的入侵并非出于金钱动机，挑战了常见的犯罪型叛论。文章探讨网络事件中的动机归因之混乱，政治、黑客行动或情报工作与犯罪之间的界线可能模糊。强调在处理凭证泄露、威胁情报与此类主张时需保持谨慎和核实。

items.title_en: Side-stepping the Secretary Problem, unwittingly
items.title_zh: 无意中绕过秘书问题
items.summary_en: The article argues that certain hiring practices unintentionally sidestep the Secretary Problem logic by relying on pre-screening or automation, potentially biasing selections. It advocates explicit sampling and validation to preserve selection quality.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出某些招聘做法在无意中回避了秘书问题的最优停止原则，借助预筛和自动化筛选可能带来偏差。倡导明确的抽样与验证以维持选才质量。

items.title_en: MUNI Heritage Weekend in San Francisco
items.title_zh: 旧金山 MUNI 传承周末
items.summary_en: MUNI Heritage Weekend spotlights San Francisco's municipal transit history, with vintage vehicles and tours that celebrate the city's public transport legacy. It's a reminder of the technology and infrastructure that underpins urban mobility.
items.summary_zh: 旧金山 MUNI 传承周末聚焦城市交通历史，展出复古车辆并举办导览，纪念这座城市公共交通的科技与基建传统。

items.title_en: Web-based IBM 1620 emulator and IPL-V from 1963
items.title_zh: 基于网络的 IBM 1620 仿真器与 IPL-V 1963
items.summary_en: A web-based IBM 1620 emulator and IPL-V interpreter lets enthusiasts explore historic computing in the browser, preserving legacy software and teaching computing history. The project highlights how emulation lowers barriers to experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 一个可在浏览器中运行的 IBM 1620 仿真器及 IPL-V 解释器，使爱好者能够在现代环境中体验历史计算，帮助保存遗留软件并传授计算机史。仿真技术降低了学习与实验的门槛。

items.title_en: How did AMD Ryzen get 50% faster in two years?
items.title_zh: 两年让 AMD Ryzen 提速 50% 是怎么做到的？
items.summary_en: The post dissects the drivers behind AMD Ryzen's rapid performance gains, including microarchitectural improvements, process technology progress, clock speed, cache design, and memory subsystem optimizations. It cautions against simple benchmarks and highlights real-world implications for gamers and enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: 文章分析 AMD Ryzen 近两年来性能提升的多重因素，如微架构改进、制程进步、时钟与缓存设计、以及内存子系统优化。提醒读者避免单一基准的误导，并讨论对游戏与高端用户的实际影响。

items.title_en: George Lucas Returns to Earth, Bearing Gifts
items.title_zh: 乔治·卢卡斯重返地球，带来礼物
items.summary_en: George Lucas returns to Earth bearing gifts, signaling renewed philanthropic or creative engagements.
items.summary_zh: 乔治·卢卡斯重返地球，带来礼物，预示着在电影、教育或科技领域的公益或合作的新亮相。

items.title_en: There is no epidemic of loneliness, but there is an epidemic of scurvy
items.title_zh: 没有孤独的流行病，但确实有坏血病的流行
items.summary_en: The author challenges the notion that loneliness has become a societal epidemic, urging nuance in interpreting social data. It juxtaposes this claim with a reminder of historical public-health issues like scurvy tied to nutrition, illustrating how resource constraints shape health metrics. The piece invites readers to rethink research priorities and the kinds of interventions that actually move the needle.
items.summary_zh: 作者对“孤独已成流行病”的说法提出质疑，强调解读社会数据时需更具层次感。文章将这一论断与历史公共卫生问题如坏血病的营养根源对比，展示资源约束如何影响健康指标。它呼吁重新思考研究重点与真正能产生实效的干预措施。

items.title_en: No Easy Fix for Bogus Respondents in Online Opt-In Polls
items.title_zh: 在线自愿参与民调中的虚假回应者难以轻易解决
items.summary_en: Online opt-in polls are plagued by bogus respondents and there is no simple remedy. The piece surveys why bot activity, fraudulent accounts, and self-selection distort results, and recommends robust validation, triangulation with other methods, and transparent reporting of limitations.
items.summary_zh: 在线自愿参与民调中存在虚假回应者，难以简单修复。机器人、伪造账户和自选偏好扭曲结果，因此需多重验证、方法三角化和透明披露局限性。

items.title_en: The Download: why AI's latest breakthroughs and fears may be more hype than rea
items.title_zh: 下载：AI 最新突破与恐惧或许比真实情况更像炒作
items.summary_en: It argues that a lot of touted AI progress rests on narrow benchmarks, not broad intelligence, and public fears may outpace actual capability. The piece urges readers to demand rigorous evaluation, reproducibility, and transparency around datasets and compute. It also notes that hype can attract investment and policy attention even when real breakthroughs are incremental.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为许多被吹捧的 AI 进展依赖狭窄的基准，而非真正的通用智能；公众的担忧可能超出实际能力。作者呼吁对数据集、计算资源等保持严格的评估、可重复性与透明度。并指出即便进展只是渐进，炒作也能带来投资和政策关注。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra has made a major breakthrough in the Goldbach Conjecture
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 在哥德巴赫猜想上取得重大突破
items.summary_en: An AI claim that GPT-6 Astra achieved a major breakthrough on Goldbach's conjecture surfaces questions about AI-assisted mathematics. If true, it could mark a milestone in automated theorem proving; if not, it's an example of hype.
items.summary_zh: 关于 GPT-6 Astra 在哥德巴赫猜想上取得重大突破的说法，引发对 AI 助力数学研究的质疑。文章强调大模型可能帮助发现模式，但需要独立验证与同行评审。若属实，或标志自动定理证明的里程碑；若不属实，也展示了炒作的典型案例。

items.title_en: The softness of metal
items.title_zh: 金属的柔软之处
items.summary_en: The piece uses metal’s softness as a lens to reflect on aging, resilience, and the human side of heavy metal culture, weaving materials science intuition with a musician’s frailty and final performance.
items.summary_zh: 本文以金属的柔软性为比喻，探讨重金属文化中的衰老、韧性与个人命运，结合材料科学直觉与一位音乐人最终演出的现实情感。

items.title_en: Porsche puts wireless EV charging into production
items.title_zh: 保时捷将无线电动车充电投入量产
items.summary_en: Porsche begins production of wireless EV charging, moving beyond prototypes to real-world deployment. The move highlights a push toward hands-free charging, grid integration considerations, and user experience implications for EV adoption.
items.summary_zh: 保时捷正式将无线电动车充电投入量产，迈出原型阶段到实际部署的步伐。此举凸显了无缝充电、与电网的协同以及对电动汽车普及的用户体验影响。

items.title_en: One Minute Park
items.title_zh: 一分钟公园
items.summary_en: One Minute Park offers a rapid, one-minute glimpse into a park, likely a micro-documentary or shorts project. It emphasizes speed and mood over breadth, inviting bite-sized urban observation.
items.summary_zh: One Minute Park 带来对公园的一分钟快速窥探，强调情绪与氛围，而非覆盖全景的叙述，适合城市观察的短格式表达。

items.title_en: Delta: Highly available, strongly consistent storage using chain replication (2022)
items.title_zh: Delta：使用链式复制实现高可用且强一致性的存储
items.summary_en: Delta demonstrates chain replication for highly available, strongly consistent storage—explaining how the protocol handles writes, replication order, and failure scenarios to achieve data durability.
items.summary_zh: Delta 通过链式复制实现高可用与强一致性的分布式存储，介绍写入顺序、复制流程与故障处理等设计要点，强调数据持久性与可用性。

items.title_en: The OpenEvidence Model Family
items.title_zh: OpenEvidence 模型家族
items.summary_en: OpenEvidence presents a model family focused on evidence-driven, interpretable AI, with modular components and evaluation to quantify uncertainty. It outlines the philosophy and potential impact on trustworthy decision-making.
items.summary_zh: OpenEvidence 推出以证据驱动、可解释的 AI 模型家族，强调不确定性量化、模块化设计与评估方法，旨在支持可信的决策。

items.title_en: The (AI) Nature of the Firm
items.title_zh: （AI）时代的企业本质
items.summary_en: This piece rethinks the organization in the age of AI, arguing that AI shifts decision-making, outsourcing, and ownership boundaries within firms. It explores how AI agents may reconfigure governance, contracts, and the relationship between workers and machines. The takeaway is that AI could redefine what a 'firm' looks like in practice, not just in theory.
items.summary_zh: 本文在 AI 时代重新审视企业本质，认为 AI 将改变企业内部的决策权、外包边界和所有权关系。探讨 AI 代理可能如何重塑治理结构、契约安排，以及员工与机器之间的关系。核心观点是，AI 可能在实践中重新定义“公司”的形态，而不仅仅是理论讨论。

items.title_en: Truman World
items.title_zh: 特鲁曼世界
items.summary_en: Truman World appears to be an experimental world-building project or game, inviting users into a constructed environment with its own rules. It showcases immersive tech or storytelling, possibly blending live events and digital content.
items.summary_zh: Truman World 可能是一个实验性世界构建项目或游戏，带你进入一个有自身规则的构建环境。它可能结合沉浸式技术与叙事、将线下活动与数字内容融合。

items.title_en: Make Math Automatic with Mathy
items.title_zh: 用 Mathy 实现数学自动化
items.summary_en: Mathy automates math tasks, turning problems into steps or code, accelerating exploration for researchers and learners. It highlights benefits and cautions about correctness and limitations.
items.summary_zh: Mathy 将数学任务自动化，将问题转化为步骤或代码，提升研究与学习的效率。与此同时提醒用户注意正确性与潜在局限。

items.title_en: The trouble with 'ntile()'
items.title_zh: ntile() 的问题
items.summary_en: ntile() can distribute data into equal-sized buckets but is sensitive to ties; depending on ordering, it can mislead about quantiles and create unstable buckets.
items.summary_zh: ntile() 将数据划分为等大小的桶，但对并列值的处理可能导致分位数误导或桶不稳定。文中指出常见陷阱并给出更合适的做法。

items.title_en: Rabbit Hole: Minimum L-seams
items.title_zh: 兔子洞：最小 L-缝
items.summary_en: Delves into minimum L-seams, unpacking its significance in geometry and algorithmic contexts and what it reveals about optimization.
items.summary_zh: 对最小 L-缝这一概念进行深入探究，分析其在几何与算法中的意义及对优化问题的启示。
